pages.text: Maldacena and Susskind: two entangled particles are joined by a wormhole too small to cross. The $(item)ER=EPR Weaver$() makes pairs and sends their halves to two mouths. Fidelity falls with the distance and with the weaver's own heat - and every pair heats it. Cold, and close, it weaves an $(item)ER Bridge Thread$().

AdS/CFT: gravity inside a space is a quantum field theory on its boundary. The Holographic Encoder turns a holographic matrix, an island and quantum spacetime condensate into a $(item)Holographic Screen$(), and a screen and Hall bars into a $(item)Boundary CFT Chip$(). For gravity in three dimensions, the boundary theory's central charge is exactly 3L/2G.
